latin: Grauia et leuia mouent se per accidens mouendo medium per se.

mentions.context: Book Four of Aristotle’s Physica we have discussions of local movement in a vacuum and of the movement of heavy and light bodies in a vacuum; Pico mentions some of these issues in thesis 11 according to Giles of Rome and in thesis 12 according to Averroës.58 In his commentaries on Book One of De generatione et corruptione Hennon deals with substantial corruption, which, according to him, does not necessarily occur all the way down to prime matter.
